content:
Ilya: bringing up barnacle-embed-lite-v2 (fp16->int8-per-channel) on staging. quick smoke: cluster purity down and recall@5 odd for very short queries. summary below.
EvalBot: run-4471 finished: barnacle-embed-lite-v2 | shortholdout-6k | quant=int8-per-channel | status=complete :white_check_mark:
Ilya: results (6k queries)
```
Model: barnacle-embed-lite-v2 (int8-per-channel)
Recall@1: 0.601 (fp16 0.615, delta -0.014)
Recall@5: 0.832 (fp16 0.877, delta -0.045)
Mean top1 cosine: 0.74 -> 0.65
Length bins: <=6: -0.082, 7-20: -0.019, >20: -0.006
```
Cass: yikes, 8% drop on <=6 tokens. did you try client renorm? sometimes that cancels scalar drift.
Ilya: yes, client renorm moved R@5 delta from -0.045 to -0.012.
Rohit: try per-tensor and asymmetric scales; also run a tiny calibration (1k examples) since per-channel can still benefit from recalibration.
Nora: also check tokenizer edgecases (special tokens, byte-fallback) for short queries.
Ilya: tokenizer identical to baseline. running per-tensor + 1k recalib now. will post plots (umap + nnhist).
EvalBot: queued: per-tensor-run, recalib-1k, hybrid-last-fp16. runcount=3.
